fields.channel_id: Primary key identifying a marketing channel.
fields.base_ctr: Synthetic reference click-through rate used when generating daily data; not a reported campaign KPI.
fields.click_to_lead_rate: Synthetic reference click-to-lead rate used in data generation; not a measured outcome.
fields.base_cpc: Synthetic reference cost per click in INR used in data generation.

fields.region: Broad Indian region for the target city.

daily_performance.csv.grain: One row per campaign per reported performance date (not every calendar day is reported).

fields.performance_id: Primary key for a daily performance record.
fields.performance_date: Date of the reported advertising performance.
fields.clicks: Number of clicks; always less than or equal to impressions.

fields.lead_source: Channel ID associated with the lead; foreign key to marketing_channels.channel_id.

conversions.csv.grain: One row per converted lead; a lead can have at most one conversion record in this dataset.

fields.conversion_date: Conversion date; generated 1–30 days after lead date.
fields.order_value_inr: Attributed order value in INR; synthetic revenue proxy.
